title: Box will add Nvidia embeddings for agent search. The rollout is early next year
friendlyTitle: Box will use Nvidia's embeddings for agent search. It arrives early next year
summary: At its developer conference on Thursday, Box showed Box Content Retrieval, which builds Nvidia's Nemotron embedding models into search for agents. TechCrunch says it will be available to Enterprise Advance customers, rolling out early next year. Nvidia's vice president of generative AI software, Kari Briski, told TechCrunch she expects queries to be answered four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens. Those figures are her expectation, not a published independent measurement. Box chief executive Aaron Levie said an agent can receive the relevant chunks instead of reading each document. He also said the system depends on Box's existing metadata and permission controls, and that the open weights alone do not recreate it.
friendlySummary: At its developer conference on Thursday, Box showed a feature called Box Content Retrieval. It builds Nvidia's Nemotron embedding models into search for agents. Embeddings are a way of storing the meaning of a passage so a search can find related text, not only matching words. TechCrunch says the feature will be available to Enterprise Advance customers, rolling out early next year. Nvidia's vice president of generative AI software, Kari Briski, told TechCrunch she expects answers four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens. Those numbers are what she expects. They are not an independent published test. Box chief executive Aaron Levie said an agent can get the relevant pieces of a document instead of reading every file. He also said the system depends on metadata and permission controls Box already has, and that the open model weights alone do not recreate it.
whyItMatters: If your files are in Box, this is not on today. Early next year is the date, and Enterprise Advance is the plan. Until then, an agent that reads a whole folder is still reading a whole folder. When it does arrive, the check is whether the chunk it returns is the clause you meant, and whether the permission model still hides the file the agent should not see.
